provenance: OPSAI-6922 plan rev7 p-1 (monorepo PR #10521, merge b2207815) — scripts/__tests__/fixtures/agentenv-admission-ceiling-vectors.json. Values transcribed from the approved plan and the 19/11/2026 node reading quoted on the card; the monorepo file itself was not readable from this sandbox, so no number here was re-measured or invented.

vectors.name: measured-node-19-11-112.62gib-14vcpu
vectors.detail: The 19/11 reading on the card: 120925978624 bytes (115324 MiB, the same figure the runtime pod reports) and 14 vCPUs. The 8 GiB margin leaves 107132 MiB, and 14 x 200% floors at 28 cores.

vectors.name: n2-highmem-16-125.8gib-16vcpu
vectors.detail: 128819 MiB (125.8 GiB) and 16 vCPUs from the 05/11 measurement used by filter_capacity_test.go; 117.8 GiB and 32 cores.

vectors.name: same-node-altered-reading-118gib
vectors.detail: The same size of node reporting 118 GiB must follow the altered reading: 110 GiB.

vectors.name: total-below-margin-floors-at-zero
vectors.detail: A total smaller than the margin produces a zero ceiling, never a negative one.

vectors.name: absent-memory-total-is-capacity-unknown
vectors.detail: The margin key is declared and the snapshot carries no memory total: capacity_unknown, never legacy and never a fail-open.

vectors.name: absent-cpu-count-is-capacity-unknown
vectors.detail: The margin key is declared and the snapshot carries no CPU count: capacity_unknown.

vectors.name: margin-below-floor-is-refused
vectors.detail: A margin below 8 GiB is a floor, not a preference: the leaf refuses it with capacity_unknown.

vectors.name: legacy-cap-squeezes-the-large-node
vectors.detail: 121332826112 bytes (113 GiB) enters only as min: it squeezes the 117.8 GiB ceiling of the 125.8 GiB node down to 113 GiB.

vectors.name: legacy-cap-is-inert-on-the-measured-node
vectors.detail: The same 113 GiB cap never raises the 104.62 GiB ceiling of the measured node.

vectors.name: contract-absent-negative-control
vectors.detail: Negative control for accidental activation: with the margin key absent the leaf stays on the legacy path, Applied is false and the declared caps behave as today.
